title: release-engineering-meeting-notes-2026-08-11
content:
Release Engineering - Meeting Notes
Date: 2026-08-11
Time: 10:00 - 11:00 PT
Location: Zoom / #release-engineering Slack
Attendees: Aisha Kapoor (notes), Mateo Gomez, Lina Chen, Ravi Patel, Samir O'Neill, Priya Rao (SRE), Ben Torres (infra)

Agenda:
- Sync on current release train (v2026.08.2)
- Hotfix status for customer-reported issue (latency regression)
- Changelog freeze and publish cadence
- Backfill / rollback readiness and playbook updates
- Action items and owners

Meeting summary:
1) Release train v2026.08.2
- Release window is scheduled for 2026-08-13 00:00 UTC (canary) and 2026-08-14 06:00 UTC (global rollout).
- Scope: Serving runtime improvements (attention kernel swap), batching optimizer, and console UI bug fixes.
- Build status: All CI jobs green except one flaky e2e test (billing-summary) — test is marked flaky and team will proceed with canary; e2e flakiness ticket created (JIRA-RELEASE-7891).
- Canary targets: 5% traffic to dedicated canary pool in us-west1, 1% in eu-west1 for cross-region verification.

2) Hotfix: latency regression (customer A) — JIRA-HOTFIX-8042
- Incident: After the last regen, a tail-latency regression observed on long-sequence workloads > 4096 tokens for a small set of models.
- Impact: Affected one enterprise customer with Dedicated deployment; increased p95 by ~120ms and p99 by ~350ms on certain model variants.
- Mitigation applied: Temporary route-based rollback to previous kernel (ker24) for customer A and their route was pinned.
- Root cause hypothesis: New KV-cache compaction heuristic interacts poorly with attention kernel swap under low-batch, long-seq workloads.
- Next steps:
  - Engineering to add telemetry to capture compaction trigger rates and per-request kernel selection (owner: Mateo, due: 2026-08-12).
  - Add a targeted unit + integration test for long-sequence behavior in CI (owner: Lina, due: 2026-08-18).
  - Prepare a hotfix release candidate that reverts compaction heuristic for affected kernel path (owner: Ravi, draft branch ready, due: 2026-08-12).

3) Changelog and release notes
- Changelog freeze set for 2026-08-12 23:59 PT. Product docs will publish release notes on 2026-08-14 after rollout completes.
- Action: Consolidate PR summaries into release-notes draft (owner: Samir, PR: github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/3421, due: 2026-08-12).
- Include known issues section: list hotfix and guidance for Dedicated customers (how to pin routes, contact support).

4) Rollback and fallback readiness
- Rollback playbook reviewed; playbook updated with step to pin kernel version and to revert compaction config quickly (playbook doc: CONFLUENCE-RELEASE-2026-08).
- SRE to run a tabletop simulation of rollback for the canary next week (owner: Priya, exercise scheduled: 2026-08-12 16:00 PT).

5) Quality gates / metrics to watch during canary
- p50/p95/p99 token latency for top 10 models
- error rate (5xx) and rate of kernel fallback events
- KV-cache compaction triggers per minute
- billing/quotas anomaly (to catch sudden surge in requests)
- autoscaler spillover events
- Dashboards: /dashboards/release-v2026.08.2 (console)

6) Post-release retrospective plan
- Set QTR postmortem checkpoint: two weeks after full rollout (2026-08-28). Collect prompts, eval regressions, and customer feedback (owner: Aisha).

Open issues and blockers:
- Billing-summary e2e flake needs triage; if it flakes in canary, we should consider delaying non-critical console changes. (owner: Ben, due: 2026-08-12)
- Test coverage gap for long-sequence low-batch scenarios (owner: Lina, due: 2026-08-18).

Action items (owner — due):
- Mateo — Add compaction & kernel telemetry; roll hotfix branch if telemetry confirms hypothesis — 2026-08-12.
- Ravi — Prepare hotfix candidate that reverts compaction heuristic on affected kernel paths; publish release candidate and smoke tests — 2026-08-12.
- Lina — Add long-sequence integration test & update CI matrix to include >4096 token runs (lower cadence to save infra) — 2026-08-18.
- Samir — Draft release notes and changelog entries; include known issues and rollback steps PR — 2026-08-12.
- Priya (SRE) — Run rollback tabletop exercise and verify runbooks for canary targets — 2026-08-12.
- Ben — Triage billing-summary e2e flake and decide mitigation path — 2026-08-12.

Notes / references:
- Customer A support thread: slack://channels/C03ABC123/customer-a-latency (internal)
- Hotfix ticket: JIRA-HOTFIX-8042
- Release plan: CONFLUENCE-RELEASE-2026-08
- GH PR with release notes draft: github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/3421

Next meeting:
- Quick sync on telemetry and hotfix progress: 2026-08-12 09:30 PT (15m)
- Full release engineering weekly: 2026-08-18 10:00 PT

End of notes.
